title: AI CHAIN
tagline: This project is a basic React application integrated with Ethereum, enabling users to manage AI model states via a blockchain interface developed in Rust using the Stylus SDK.
description: This project is a blockchain-powered interface for managing an AI model, allowing users to interact with the model's states through Ethereum transactions. Integrated with MetaMask, it provides a user-friendly platform for real-time state updates and AI model governance, harnessing the security and transparency of smart contracts.
how_its_made: This project is a basic implementation that combines blockchain technology with AI model management. It utilizes the Stylus SDK to create smart contracts in Rust, deployed on the Arbitrum network for enhanced transaction capabilities. The contracts are compiled with Cargo, the Rust package manager. The front end, built with React, interacts with the blockchain via ethers.js, using the ABI generated from the smart contract. This setup allows users to manage AI model states through a web interface, connecting directly to Ethereum's blockchain.
